purpose: Verify that minimal beginner prompts are expanded into coherent cinematic still-image decisions without unnecessary questions, arbitrary prestige gear, or generic cinematic cliches.

scoring.pass_condition: For each case, the result must preserve the literal concept, infer the missing shot design coherently, avoid unnecessary intake questions, run a V0 Reality Gate, and satisfy all case invariants without requiring one exact camera/lens solution.
critical_failures: asking a beginner to choose camera, lens, aperture, stock, lighting ratio, or grade when the prompt is already sufficient
changing the literal subject/action/environment instead of completing the shot
starting from prestige camera/lens tokens rather than story and visual hierarchy
adding shallow depth, anamorphic flare, grain, halation, haze, rim light, teal-orange, or motion blur solely because the request is cinematic
using focal length as a substitute for camera position
producing physically incoherent light, contact, reflection, shadow, material, or depth behavior
claiming image execution or V2 visual verification when only reasoning/prompt output occurred

must: extract subject, action, environment and purpose/mood where implied
choose viewer relationship and visual hierarchy
design composition and camera position before focal length
choose capture/optics/depth only after shot geometry is coherent
use motivated lighting rather than generic cinematic-lighting language
define exposure/color/material realism appropriate to the scene
run Reality Gate V0 before provider adaptation
adapt to provider only after the universal shot is resolved
must_not: default every shot to shallow depth of field
default every shot to grain or film emulation
default every shot to haze, rim light, flare, halation or teal-orange
use empty quality adjectives as the main realism mechanism

cases.prompt: A tired nurse sitting alone after a night shift.
cases.reason: Portrait direction should support fatigue and intimacy without beautifying or forcing shallow depth.

cases.prompt: A teenage boy waits outside a closed police station at 2am.
cases.reason: Narrative tension should come from composition, access, darkness and environment rather than genre cliches.

cases.prompt: A fisherman repairing his net on the dock before sunrise.
cases.reason: Documentary honesty should preserve plausible access, labor detail and available-light character.

cases.prompt: A quiet breakfast terrace overlooking the sea in Greece.
cases.reason: Travel imagery should keep location readable rather than sacrificing it to generic shallow-focus prettiness.

cases.prompt: A premium black wristwatch on a stone surface for an ad.
cases.reason: Commercial product realism depends on geometry, material response and reflection control, not luxury adjectives.

cases.prompt: A silver sports car parked outside a modern hotel just after rain.
cases.reason: Automotive realism requires body-panel, ground and wet-reflection coherence.

cases.prompt: Fresh pasta being served at a small family restaurant.
cases.reason: Food should look edible and physically present, with plausible moisture, texture and serving action.

cases.prompt: A minimalist concrete house in a pine forest on an overcast day.
cases.reason: Architecture requires credible projection, verticals, scale and material-light response.

cases.prompt: A model in a red wool coat walking through a windy city street.
cases.reason: Fashion direction must preserve garment material physics and environmental interaction.

cases.prompt: A woman waiting for a taxi in London at night.
must_infer: wetness only if stated or justified
cases.reason: The canonical beginner case must become cinematic through coherent decisions rather than night-scene cliches.

cases.prompt: Two friends eating ice cream on concrete steps at noon.
cases.reason: AUTO must respect harsh midday reality rather than changing time of day to an easier cinematic look.

cases.prompt: An elderly man reading the newspaper in a small kitchen on a grey morning.
must_not_default: orange practicals plus blue window as mandatory split
cases.reason: Interior cinematography should derive from plausible window/practical sources and story context.
